errors.description: The final exponential-divisibility characterization is false under the stated condition: primes absent from all initial numbers may be inserted into d, since a positive exponent divides 0, so no unique maximal d need exist. This does not affect the proof.
errors.quote: the unique maximal $d$ with $v_p(d) \mid v_p(a_i)$ for all $p$ and all $i$.

parsed.notes: Parts (a) and (b) are complete and correct. The termination potential and prime-wise gcd invariants rigorously establish both required conclusions; only the nonessential final remark is erroneous.
